title: European Communities Study, 1973
contributors: Commission of the European Communities * Brussels, Belgium (research initiator)

IFOP * Paris, FranceDimarso, Inra * BelgiumNIPO bv * AmsterdamEmnid Institut * Bielefeld, GermanyDoxa * Milan, ItalyGallup marked analyse * Copenhagen, DenmarkIrish Marketing Surveys ltd * Dublin, IrelandGallup Poll * London, Great Britain (data collector)
descriptions: This study can be considered as the start of the Eurobarometer series. It focuses on satisfaction with various aspects of life and society and European unification. Themes: satisfaction with conditions of living, society, democracy / expectations for the future / respect / job values / environment / political attitudes and values / desirable goals for society / cosmopolitan attitudes / information on the EC / awareness of the EC / support for the EC / political problems / goals for EC / support for political unification / political involvement / opinion leadership / left-right self-placement / left-right partisanship index / post - materialist index ( Inglehart ). Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ politics/ religion/ organizational membership
